<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Global Aid Alliance — Together We Respond</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    :root {
      --red-primary: #C41E3A;
      --red-dark: #9B1830;
      --red-light: #E63950;
      --navy: #1B3A5C;
      --navy-dark: #0F2439;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #F8F9FA;
      --gray-100: #F1F3F5;
      --gray-200: #E9ECEF;
      --gray-300: #DEE2E6;
      --gray-400: #CED4DA;
      --gray-500: #ADB5BD;
      --gray-600: #6C757D;
      --gray-700: #495057;
      --gray-800: #343A40;
      --gray-900: #212529;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      --transition-fast: 150ms ease;
      --transition-normal: 250ms ease;
      --transition-slow: 350ms ease;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      background: var(--white);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    /* Skip Link */
    .skip-link {
      position: absolute;
      top: -100%;
      left: 16px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      background: var(--red-primary);
      color: white;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-radius: 4px;
      z-index: 9999;
      transition: top var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .skip-link:focus {
      top: 16px;
    }

    /* Container */
    .container {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* Header */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      z-index: 100;
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--red-primary);
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-icon svg {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      color: white;
    }

    .logo-text {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .nav-desktop {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 28px;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      color: var(--gray-700);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      color: var(--red-primary);
    }

    .nav-utils {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-left: 24px;
      padding-left: 24px;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .nav-utils a {
      color: var(--gray-600);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-utils a:hover {
      color: var(--red-primary);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .btn:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--red-primary);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--red-primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--red-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--navy-dark);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--red-primary);
      border: 2px solid var(--red-primary);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      background: var(--red-primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .btn-lg {
      padding: 16px 32px;
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    /* Hamburger */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      margin-right: -8px;
    }

    .hamburger:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--red-primary);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--gray-800);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    /* Mobile Menu */
    .mobile-menu {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 99;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .mobile-menu.open {
      display: block;
    }

    .mobile-menu-inner {
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .mobile-nav-links a {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 500;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .mobile-nav-links a:hover {
      background: var(--gray-100);
    }

    .mobile-nav-links .btn {
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .mobile-utils {
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding-top: 24px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .mobile-utils a {
      color: var(--gray-600);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      padding: 140px 0 100px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-50) 0%, var(--white) 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      width: 50%;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0%, rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.03) 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-content {
      max-width: 560px;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      background: rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.08);
      color: var(--red-primary);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: 56px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }

    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .hero-image {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      background: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .hero-image img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .hero-image-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-100) 0%, var(--gray-200) 100%);
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    /* Mission */
    .mission {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .mission-inner {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--red-primary);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .section-label::before,
    .section-label::after {
      content: '';
      width: 20px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--red-primary);
      border-radius: 1px;
    }

    .mission-title {
      font-size: 40px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .mission-text {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    /* Impact Stats */
    .impact {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
    }

    .impact-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 48px;
    }

    .impact-stat {
      text-align: center;
    }

    .impact-number {
      font-size: 56px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .impact-number .suffix {
      font-size: 40px;
    }

    .impact-label {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Programs */
    .programs {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .programs-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .programs-title {
      font-size: 40px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .programs-subtitle {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .accordion {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .accordion-item {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition-normal);
    }

    .accordion-item:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .accordion-trigger {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 24px 28px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .accordion-trigger:hover {
      color: var(--red-primary);
    }

    .accordion-trigger:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--red-primary);
      outline-offset: -3px;
    }

    .accordion-icon {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: transform var(--transition-normal);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .accordion-icon svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .accordion-item.open .accordion-icon {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .accordion-content {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .accordion-item.open .accordion-content {
      max-height: 500px;
    }

    .accordion-body {
      padding: 0 28px 28px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* Get Involved */
    .get-involved {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .get-involved-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .get-involved-title {
      font-size: 40px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .involve-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .involve-card {
      padding: 36px 32px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: 16px;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-normal);
    }

    .involve-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .involve-icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      background: rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.1);
      border-radius: 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
    }

    .involve-icon svg {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      color: var(--red-primary);
    }

    .involve-card h3 {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .involve-card p {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* News */
    .news {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .news-title {
      font-size: 40px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .news-nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .news-nav-btn {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-300);
      background: var(--white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .news-nav-btn:hover {
      background: var(--red-primary);
      border-color: var(--red-primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .news-nav-btn:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--red-primary);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .news-nav-btn svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
    }

    .carousel {
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
    }

    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(33.333% - 16px);
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all var(--transition-normal);
    }

    .news-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .news-image {
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      background: var(--gray-200);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-image img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .news-image-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-100) 0%, var(--gray-200) 100%);
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .news-content {
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .news-category {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      background: rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.1);
      color: var(--red-primary);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .news-card h3 {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .news-card p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Donate CTA */
    .donate-cta {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--red-primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .donate-cta-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .donate-cta-content h2 {
      font-size: 44px;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .donate-cta-content p {
      font-size: 18px;
      opacity: 0.9;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .impact-table {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 32px;
    }

    .impact-table h3 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .impact-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 12px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    }

    .impact-row:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .impact-row .amount {
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
    }

    .impact-row .desc {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .donate-cta-btn {
      background: white;
      color: var(--red-primary);
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .donate-cta-btn:hover {
      background: var(--gray-100);
    }

    /* Footer */
    .footer {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: white;
      padding: 80px 0 40px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-brand p {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-top: 20px;
      max-width: 280px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    }

    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .footer-col a:hover {
      color: white;
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      padding-top: 40px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .footer-bottom p {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-social a {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .footer-social a:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    }

    .footer-social svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      color: white;
    }

    /* Donation Modal */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      z-index: 200;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: all var(--transition-normal);
    }

    .modal-overlay.open {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .modal {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      max-width: 500px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      transform: scale(0.95) translateY(20px);
      transition: transform var(--transition-normal);
    }

    .modal-overlay.open .modal {
      transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
    }

    .modal-header {
      padding: 28px 32px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .modal-header h2 {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .modal-close {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: none;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .modal-close:hover {
      background: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .modal-close:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--red-primary);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .modal-close svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .modal-body {
      padding: 32px;
    }

    .donate-amounts {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .amount-option {
      padding: 16px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .amount-option:hover {
      border-color: var(--red-primary);
      background: rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.03);
    }

    .amount-option.selected {
      border-color: var(--red-primary);
      background: var(--red-primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .amount-option:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--red-primary);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .amount-option .amount {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: block;
    }

    .amount-option .impact {
      font-size: 11px;
      opacity: 0.7;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .custom-amount {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .custom-amount label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .custom-amount input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .custom-amount input:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--red-primary);
    }

    .donate-submit {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px;
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .donate-note {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .hero-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 48px;
      }

      .hero-content {
        max-width: 100%;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .hero-ctas {
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .impact-inner {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 40px;
      }

      .involve-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        max-width: 480px;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }

      .donate-cta-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 48px;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-desktop {
        display: none;
      }

      .hamburger {
        display: flex;
      }

      .hero {
        padding: 120px 0 80px;
      }

      .hero-title {
        font-size: 36px;
      }

      .hero-subtitle {
        font-size: 17px;
      }

      .impact-number {
        font-size: 40px;
      }

      .impact-number .suffix {
        font-size: 28px;
      }

      .news-header {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 24px;
      }

      .news-card {
        flex: 0 0 100%;
      }

      .donate-cta-content h2 {
        font-size: 32px;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 32px;
      }

      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 24px;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .mission-title,
      .programs-title,
      .get-involved-title,
      .news-title {
        font-size: 32px;
      }

      .donate-amounts {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <a href="#main" class="skip-link">Skip to main content</a>

  <!-- Header -->
  <header class="header">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="header-inner">
        <a href="/" class="logo" aria-label="Global Aid Alliance Home">
          <div class="logo-icon">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 21a9 9 0 0 1 0-18c4.97 0 9 3.582 9 8s-4.03 8-9 8a9 9 0 0 1-5.56-1.86L3 21l2.47-5.47A9 9 0 0 1 12 21z" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <span class="logo-text">Global Aid Alliance</span>
        </a>

        <nav class="nav-desktop" aria-label="Main navigation">
          <ul class="nav-links">
            <li><a href="#about">About Us</a></li>
            <li><a href="#programs">Disaster Relief</a></li>
            <li><a href="#programs">Programs & Services</a></li>
            <li><a href="#involve">Volunteer</a></li>
            <li><a href="#">Find Local Chapter</a></li>
          </ul>
          <div class="nav-utils">
            <a href="#">Sign In</a>
            <a href="#">Contact Us</a>
            <a href="#">Español</a>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openDonateModal()">Donate</button>
          </div>
        </nav>

        <button class="hamburger" onclick="toggleMobileMenu()" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false" id="hamburger">
          <span></span>
          <span></span>
          <span></span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- Mobile Menu -->
  <div class="mobile-menu" id="mobileMenu">
    <div class="mobile-menu-inner">
      <ul class="mobile-nav-links">
        <li><a href="#about" onclick="closeMobileMenu()">About Us</a></li>
        <li><a href="#programs" onclick="closeMobileMenu()">Disaster Relief</a></li>
        <li><a href="#programs" onclick="closeMobileMenu()">Programs & Services</a></li>
        <li><a href="#involve" onclick="closeMobileMenu()">Volunteer</a></li>
        <li><a href="#" onclick="closeMobileMenu()">Find Local Chapter</a></li>
        <li><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openDonateModal(); closeMobileMenu();">Donate Now</button></li>
      </ul>
      <div class="mobile-utils">
        <a href="#">Sign In</a>
        <a href="#">Contact Us</a>
        <a href="#">Español</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Hero -->
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="hero-inner">
        <div class="hero-content">
          <div class="hero-badge">
            <svg width="16" height="16" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M3.172 5.172a4 4 0 015.656 0L10 6.343l1.172-1.171a4 4 0 115.656 5.656L10 17.657l-6.828-6.829a4 4 0 010-5.656z" clip-rule="evenodd" /></svg>
            Together We Respond
          </div>
          <h1 class="hero-title">When Disaster Strikes, We're There</h1>
          <p class="hero-subtitle">From hurricanes and wildfires to global health emergencies, Global Aid Alliance delivers immediate relief and long-term recovery support to communities in crisis.</p>
          <div class="hero-ctas">
            <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" onclick="openDonateModal()">
              <svg width="20" height="20" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4.318 6.318a4.5 4.5 0 000 6.364L12 20.364l7.682-7.682a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364-6.364L12 7.636l-1.318-1.318a4.5 4.5 0 00-6.364 0z" /></svg>
              Donate Now
            </button>
            <a href="#involve" class="btn btn-secondary btn-lg">Become a Volunteer</a>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-image">
          <div class="hero-image-placeholder" aria-label="Relief workers distributing aid supplies to community members">
            <span>Image: Disaster relief workers helping communities</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Mission -->
  <section class="mission" id="about">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="mission-inner">
        <span class="section-label">Our Mission</span>
        <h2 class="mission-title">Global Aid Alliance prevents and alleviates human suffering in the face of emergencies by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors.</h2>
        <p class="mission-text">We are guided by the fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, and neutrality. Every day, our teams work across borders and boundaries to ensure that help reaches those who need it most — regardless of race, religion, nationality, or political affiliation. From the first hours of a disaster to the years of recovery that follow, we stand with affected communities every step of the way.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Impact Stats -->
  <section class="impact" id="impact">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="impact-inner">
        <div class="impact-stat">
          <div class="impact-number" data-target="12000000" data-display="12 million"><span class="count">0</span><span class="suffix"> million</span></div>
          <div class="impact-label">people assisted annually</div>
        </div>
        <div class="impact-stat">
          <div class="impact-number" data-target="50000" data-display="50,000"><span class="count">0</span><span class="suffix">K</span></div>
          <div class="impact-label">volunteers active worldwide</div>
        </div>
        <div class="impact-stat">
          <div class="impact-number" data-target="190" data-display="190"><span class="count">0</span><span class="suffix"></span></div>
          <div class="impact-label">countries where we've worked</div>
        </div>
        <div class="impact-stat">
          <div class="impact-number" data-target="850000000" data-display="$850 million"><span class="count">0</span><span class="suffix">M</span></div>
          <div class="impact-label">raised last fiscal year</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Programs -->
  <section class="programs" id="programs">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="programs-header">
        <span class="section-label">What We Do</span>
        <h2 class="programs-title">Programs and Services</h2>
        <p class="programs-subtitle">Comprehensive humanitarian solutions addressing every phase of disaster and crisis response.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="accordion">
        <div class="accordion-item">
          <button class="accordion-trigger" onclick="toggleAccordion(this)" aria-expanded="false">
            <span>Disaster Relief</span>
            <span class="accordion-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" /></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="accordion-content">
            <div class="accordion-body">Rapid deployment of emergency shelter, food, water, and medical supplies to communities affected by natural disasters and conflict. Our response teams are on the ground within 24 hours.</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="accordion-item">
          <button class="accordion-trigger" onclick="toggleAccordion(this)" aria-expanded="false">
            <span>Blood Donation</span>
            <span class="accordion-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" /></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="accordion-content">
            <div class="accordion-body">Operating one of the largest blood collection networks, we supply approximately 40% of the nation's blood and blood products to hospitals and medical facilities.</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="accordion-item">
          <button class="accordion-trigger" onclick="toggleAccordion(this)" aria-expanded="false">
            <span>Emergency Preparedness</span>
            <span class="accordion-icon"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" /></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="accordion-content">
            <div class="accordion-body">Training individuals, families, and organizations to prepare for and respond to emergencies through workshops, certification courses, and community drills.</div>
          </div>

    // Mobile Menu
    function toggleMobileMenu() {
      const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');

      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-label', isOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';

    function closeMobileMenu() {
      document.getElementById('mobileMenu').classList.remove('open');
      document.getElementById('hamburger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    // Donation Modal
    let selectedDonationAmount = 100;

    function openDonateModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
      modal.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      modal.querySelector('.amount-option.selected')?.focus();

    function closeDonateModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
      modal.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';

    function selectAmount(el, amount) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.amount-option').forEach(opt => opt.classList.remove('selected'));
      el.classList.add('selected');

      if (amount === 'custom') {
        document.getElementById('customAmount').focus();
        selectedDonationAmount = null;
      } else {
        selectedDonationAmount = amount;
        document.getElementById('customAmount').value = '';
      }
    }

    function submitDonation() {
      const customAmount = document.getElementById('customAmount').value;
      const amount = customAmount || selectedDonationAmount;

      if (!amount || parseFloat(amount) <= 0) {
        alert('Please select or enter a donation amount.');
        return;
      }

      alert('Thank you for your generous donation of $' + amount + '! This demo does not process actual payments.');
      closeDonateModal();
    }

    // Close modal on overlay click
    document.getElementById('donateModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === this) {
        closeDonateModal();
      }
    });

    // Close modal on Escape key
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeDonateModal();
        closeMobileMenu();
      }
    });

    // Accordion
    function toggleAccordion(trigger) {
      const item = trigger.closest('.accordion-item');
      const isOpen = item.classList.toggle('open');
      trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
    }

    // News Carousel
    let carouselPosition = 0;
    const carouselTrack = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');

    function getVisibleCards() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 1;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) return 2;
      return 3;
    }

    function getTotalCards() {
      return carouselTrack.children.length;
    }

    function getMaxPosition() {
      return Math.max(0, getTotalCards() - getVisibleCards());
    }

    function moveCarousel(direction) {
      const visible = getVisibleCards();
      const maxPos = getMaxPosition();

      carouselPosition += direction;
      if (carouselPosition < 0) carouselPosition = maxPos;
      if (carouselPosition > maxPos) carouselPosition = 0;

      const cardWidth = carouselTrack.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
      carouselTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${carouselPosition * cardWidth}px)`;
    }

    // Animated Counters
    function animateCounter(element, target, display) {
      const duration = 2000;
      const start = performance.now();
      const countEl = element.querySelector('.count');

      function update(currentTime) {
        const elapsed = currentTime - start;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        const current = Math.floor(target * eased);

        if (display.includes('million')) {
          countEl.textContent = (current / 1000000).toFixed(0);
        } else if (display.includes('$')) {
          countEl.textContent = (current / 1000000).toFixed(0);
        } else if (display.includes(',')) {
          countEl.textContent = current.toLocaleString();
        } else {
          countEl.textContent = current;
        }

        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        }
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }

    // Intersection Observer for counters
    const impactSection = document.querySelector('.impact');
    let countersAnimated = false;

    const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && !countersAnimated) {
          countersAnimated = true;
          document.querySelectorAll('.impact-stat').forEach(stat => {
            const numberEl = stat.querySelector('.impact-number');
            const target = parseInt(numberEl.dataset.target);
            const display = numberEl.dataset.display;
            animateCounter(numberEl, target, display);
          });
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    counterObserver.observe(impactSection);

    // Handle resize for carousel
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      carouselPosition = Math.min(carouselPosition, getMaxPosition());
      const cardWidth = carouselTrack.children[0].offsetWidth + 24;
      carouselTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${carouselPosition * cardWidth}px)`;
    });

steps.message:
Built the complete Global Aid Alliance website at `/app/output/index.html` (1862 lines, ~56KB).

**Implemented Features:**

1. **Header** — Fixed navigation with logo, nav links, utility links, and Donate button. Hamburger menu for mobile with slide-down drawer.

2. **Hero Section** — Full hero with title "When Disaster Strikes, We're There", subtitle, and dual CTAs (Donate Now + Become a Volunteer). Donate button triggers the modal.

3. **Mission Section** — Centered mission statement with professional typography.

4. **Impact Statistics** — Four animated counters (12M people, 50K volunteers, 190 countries, $850M) with intersection observer-triggered counting animation. Navy blue background for visual weight.

5. **Programs Accordion** — 5 expandable program items (Disaster Relief, Blood Donation, Emergency Preparedness, International Aid, Community Health) with smooth expand/collapse animation.

6. **Get Involved** — Three cards for Volunteer, Fundraiser, and Blood Drive with icons and CTAs.

7. **News Carousel** — Four news cards with working prev/next navigation arrows, smooth horizontal scrolling, responsive (shows 1/2/3 cards based on viewport).

8. **Donate CTA Section** — Red background with impact table showing donation amounts and their effects.

9. **Footer** — Four-column layout with Programs, Get Involved, Support links, plus social icons.

10. **Donation Modal** — 6 preset amounts ($25/$50/$100/$250/$500/Custom), custom input field, selected state highlighting, form validation.

**Design:** Deep red (#C41E3A) primary, navy blue (#1B3A5C) secondary, clean whites and warm grays. Inter font family. Fully responsive with mobile-first breakpoints. Accessible features: skip link, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus states, prefers-reduced-motion support.
